thesis: 15-minute breakout of the prior 5-hour high in an uptrend on above-average volume, with a stop 5-6% away so fees are a tenth of the risk, no partial, breakeven at 2R and a 5-ATR trail.
risks: Chosen by a 90-day sweep, so its recent results are in-sample; the stop is wide for a 15-minute entry, so trades are held for days; thin-book volume filter.
tuned: Parameters picked by a 90-day fee-aware sweep ending 2026-09-23. Any result inside that window is in-sample, including most of this report's out-of-sample period.
